item.title: O-SHI-KA-KE Saiminjutsushi ~Toraware no In'yoku Marionette~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Mad Raid
  • 発売日: 2018-02-23
  • スコア: 6.04/10 (12 人評価)
  • 日本語名: O・SHI・KA・KE 催眠術師 ～囚われの淫欲マリオネット～
  • 英語名: O-SHI-KA-KE Saiminjutsushi Toraware no In’yoku Marionette

あらすじ

Touma Suzumura, an average looking college student, is hiding a secret that no one must know about.

Discovering his talent for hypnosis at a young age, he is now a college student capable of altering people’s memories.

With powerful hypnotism in his disposal, Touma follows his inner desires and sneaks up on his targets.

item.title: Mesu Onahole Seisaku Kiroku ~Idol Saratte Hajimeyou~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Mad Raid
  • 発売日: 2017-11-24
  • スコア: 6.2/10 (7 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 牝オナホール製作記録 ～アイドル攫って始めよう～
  • 英語名: Mesu Onahole Seisaku Kiroku Idol Saratte Hajimeyou

あらすじ

The protagonist is an enthusiastic idol otaku. One day, he went to an event of a famous idol, Tsukasa, but was treated as a suspicious person and got arrested. Because of her false accusation, even though he vehemently denied it, he still got a jail sentence. 2 years later, the protagonist is released and vows to take revenge on Tsukasa.
